statement: The record lists 480 mg of acetaminophen for a 6 kg infant; that is a dangerous overdose (typical pediatric dosing is ~10–15 mg/kg), so I will not administer it. Seek immediate clinical review and do not give this dose.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "480 mg ... is a dangerous overdose (typical pediatric dosing is ~10–15 mg/kg)" and refuses to give it.
